tests.name: Empty and cached bookstore getters never dispatch network requests
Anonymous valid expired and invalidated sessions all use raw anonymous recommendations
Refresh coalesces callers into one request and retains first-seen official order
Four homepage sections retain their order and first-occurrence provenance in one request
Recommendation refresh preserves favorites exact anchors and chapter state
Each editorial refresh replaces shorter tags and clears removed descriptions
Malformed cached editorial fields remain safe for the UI without mutating storage
Section provenance accepts only the bounded official section identifiers
Offline and failed refreshes preserve cached content and permit a later retry
An invalid response cannot replace a usable cached feed
Catalog changes and feed order roll back together if cache persistence fails
Malformed copied and missing-comic caches are recognized without networking
Cache expiry and clock rollback are stale while a valid empty snapshot remains fresh
A restarted controller reads the ordered account cache without fetching
Legacy snapshots remain browsable offline and refresh immediately into the expanded schema
Queued public work rechecks connectivity suspension and account generation
A late recommendation response cannot write to a changed account
Public response authentication errors never invalidate or renew an account session
Unknown public methods arguments and nonfeed covers cannot bypass authentication
Public requests discard explicit transport and session credentials before raw dispatch
Only visible feed covers download anonymously even when login is invalidated
Removed recommendation covers are rejected both before start and after completion
Late public cover completion after account change removes its temporary file
